description: Umbrella Evidence types for the canonical Procured→Energized equipment path (core_schemas/equipment_state.yaml). Architecture packs specialize ReadyForCommission→Commissioned via sat_gate_map.json citing concrete catalogs; those concrete types satisfy SatSuitePass-class gates without replacing this registry.

types.description: Receiving inspection or bill-of-lading acceptance confirms the asset arrived as procured; unlocks Procured→Delivered.
Mechanical placement, anchorage, and install walkdown are complete; unlocks Delivered→Installed.
Pre-commission checklist (clearances, labeling, bonding themes) recorded before SAT suite entry; unlocks Installed→ReadyForCommission.

Umbrella class: the architecture pack SAT suite required for ReadyForCommission→Commissioned has passed. Packs specialize with concrete cataloged types via sat_gate_map.json; they do not invent a parallel state language.
Energization clearance after Commissioned; unlocks Commissioned→Energized. Never granted by assist alone.
